desc: Derive the visibility condition and reduce the problem to the maximum over consecutive pairs (equivalently, adjacent inversions of (H_i-h)/X_i), including the -1/zero special cases.

Fix the output formatting: keep exact rational max comparison, but print non-negative answers with 18 decimal places via float division (`f"{best_num / best_den:.18f}"`), and print exact `-1` for N==1 or negative max; verify all four samples match exactly.

Validate the implementation on random small cases against a brute-force all-pairs exact rational maximum, including N=1, zero threshold, negative threshold, equality cases, and large 1e9 values, without hardcoding sample outputs.
